project_name: Big Rooter / Twin Oaks data center capacity
status_detail: Panamint/Twin Oaks energy campus materials and local reporting describe 790 MW of data center capacity under development at the 10,000-acre Twin Oaks/Big Rooter site; solar phase construction is underway, while the data center component appears under development and not confirmed as operational.
notes: Robertson County official homepage lists relevant Chapter 312/tax-abatement and Big Rooter public hearing notices, validating direct county-site review. Primary public details are from Panamint press materials and local/news coverage; local KBTX noted it asked Panamint and county officials to clarify whether the 790 MW capacity means an actual on-site or nearby data center.

status_detail: No Rockwall County data center project found in county website/news/EDA search.

project_name: Taft Industrial Site data center-qualified site

notes: Recorded as a site/project lead because the regional EDC qualified-sites document explicitly labels a Taft site for data center use. No developer, capacity, or construction status found.
